column1: # derivation: §9.1, §9.7: ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW,
# by id. MIN and MAX skip NULL inputs (§2.1) and answer NULL over a frame of
# only NULLs (§2.2, §8.26 note). g = 1 (v 3, NULL, 5, 1, 4): min_v 3, 3, 3,
# 1, 1; max_v 3, 3, 5, 5, 5. g = 2 (v NULL, NULL): NULL, NULL for both.
# A frame stays within the current row's partition: standard SQL window
# semantics, which no item states yet.
# Types: id, g, v, w, u keep their scanned types; windowed MIN and MAX have
# v's type, INT64, nullable because v is nullable (§8.26).
